title: Malformed JSON, invalid UTF-8, bad timestamps, ignored record kinds and a missing model
policy: P7: records that can't be read are not counted, and should be reported as unread rather than vanish (the ledger keeps no such count; see the report). User records and <synthetic> records carry no billable usage and are ignored. A record without a model is counted under "unknown", whose cost is unknown.
derivation: Counted: A [100, 50], B [20, 2] (claude-test-1) and M [11, 1] (no model). Not counted: truncated JSON, invalid UTF-8, a timestamp without a zone or T, no timestamp, a user record, a <synthetic> record. 184 tokens, 3 operations.
